def lcg_next(s: int) -> int:
    """Next state of a linear congruential generator, kept in [0, 2^31) so it never overflows."""
    pre s >= 0 and s < 2147483648
    post out >= 0 and out < 2147483648
    ex lcg_next(0) == 12345
    ex lcg_next(1) == 1103527590
    return (1103515245 * s + 12345) % 2147483648

def shuffled(xs: list[int], seed: int) -> list[int]:
    """A permutation of xs whose order depends only on seed; the same xs and seed always give the same result."""
    post out.len() == xs.len()
    post sorted(out) == sorted(xs)
    ex shuffled([], 1) == []
    ex shuffled([7], 3) == [7]
    m = 2147483648
    s = (seed % m + m) % m
    res = xs.copy()
    for i in range(res.len() - 1, 0, -1):
        s = lcg_next(s)
        j = (s // 65536) % (i + 1)
        tmp = res[i]
        res[i] = res[j]
        res[j] = tmp
    return res
